title: Psalm 110
opening_line: The LORD did say unto my Lord,

source.note: Received text from the official Free Church digital edition and plain-text archive.

text.diplomatic: The LORD did say unto my Lord,
text.normalized: The LORD did say unto my Lord,
text.reading: The LORD did say unto my Lord,

text.diplomatic: Sit thou at my right hand,
text.normalized: Sit thou at my right hand,
text.reading: Sit thou at my right hand,

text.diplomatic: Until I make thy foes a stool,
text.normalized: Until I make thy foes a stool,
text.reading: Until I make thy foes a stool,

text.diplomatic: whereon thy feet may stand.
text.normalized: Whereon thy feet may stand.
text.reading: whereon thy feet may stand.

text.diplomatic: The LORD shall out of Zion send
text.normalized: The LORD shall out of Zion send
text.reading: The LORD shall out of Zion send

text.diplomatic: the rod of thy great pow’r:
text.normalized: The rod of thy great pow’r:
text.reading: the rod of thy great pow’r:

text.diplomatic: In midst of all thine enemies
text.normalized: In midst of all thine enemies
text.reading: In midst of all thine enemies

text.diplomatic: be thou the governor.
text.normalized: Be thou the governor.
text.reading: be thou the governor.

text.diplomatic: A willing people in thy day
text.normalized: A willing people in thy day
text.reading: A willing people in thy day

text.diplomatic: of pow’r shall come to thee,
text.normalized: Of pow’r shall come to thee,
text.reading: of pow’r shall come to thee,

text.diplomatic: In holy beauties from morn’s womb;
text.normalized: In holy beauties from morn’s womb;
text.reading: In holy beauties from morn’s womb;

text.diplomatic: thy youth like dew shall be.
text.normalized: Thy youth like dew shall be.
text.reading: thy youth like dew shall be.

text.diplomatic: The LORD himself hath made an oath,
text.normalized: The LORD himself hath made an oath,
text.reading: The LORD himself hath made an oath,

text.diplomatic: and will repent him never,
text.normalized: And will repent him never,
text.reading: and will repent him never,

text.diplomatic: Of th’ order of Melchizedek
text.normalized: Of th’ order of Melchizedek
text.reading: Of th’ order of Melchizedek

text.diplomatic: thou art a priest for ever.
text.normalized: Thou art a priest for ever.
text.reading: thou art a priest for ever.

text.diplomatic: The glorious and mighty Lord,
text.normalized: The glorious and mighty Lord,
text.reading: The glorious and mighty Lord,

text.diplomatic: that sits at thy right hand,
text.normalized: That sits at thy right hand,
text.reading: that sits at thy right hand,

text.diplomatic: Shall, in his day of wrath, strike through
text.normalized: Shall, in his day of wrath, strike through
text.reading: Shall, in his day of wrath, strike through

text.diplomatic: kings that do him withstand.
text.normalized: Kings that do him withstand.
text.reading: kings that do him withstand.

text.diplomatic: He shall among the heathen judge,
text.normalized: He shall among the heathen judge,
text.reading: He shall among the heathen judge,

text.diplomatic: he shall with bodies dead
text.normalized: He shall with bodies dead
text.reading: he shall with bodies dead

text.diplomatic: The places fill: o’er many lands
text.normalized: The places fill: o’er many lands
text.reading: The places fill: o’er many lands

text.diplomatic: he wound shall ev’ry head.
text.normalized: He wound shall ev’ry head.
text.reading: he wound shall ev’ry head.

text.diplomatic: The brook that runneth in the way
text.normalized: The brook that runneth in the way
text.reading: The brook that runneth in the way

text.diplomatic: with drink shall him supply;
text.normalized: With drink shall him supply;
text.reading: with drink shall him supply;

text.diplomatic: And, for this cause, in triumph he
text.normalized: And, for this cause, in triumph he
text.reading: And, for this cause, in triumph he

text.diplomatic: shall lift his head on high.
text.normalized: Shall lift his head on high.
text.reading: shall lift his head on high.
